tweet_text:
what words do llms use when prompted to write sth "beautiful"? or "poetic", or "unique"?
i counted every word in 240 generations (qwen + llama) vs a plain "write something":
beautiful: ethereal, velvet, diamonds, "time stood still"
poetic: moonlit, shadows, silent, whispers
moving: her, tears, grandmother, piano
unique: tapestry, forgotten, "not just…"
